scope: Complementary source review of resource, provenance, process ownership, receipt and packaging boundaries; numerical native physics reviewed separately.
independence: Reviewer authored ncp infrastructure; native_followup and process_control/prepare were authored by other agents. This is not an independent audit of the reviewer own implementation.
containing_source_commit: Bound by the external stage C2-C5 publication receipt, avoiding a self-reference.

finding_closures.original_issue: An outer wrapper termination could leave its separately created child process group running.
finding_closures.resolution: Production run_owned and native ChildGuard install TERM/INT handlers, block signals across spawn registration, restore child signal masks, and terminate only the exact newly created child PGID. Inner cleanup is below the outer two-second grace.

finding_closures.original_issue: Combined and control inventories could produce negative normalized residuals without positive N/U guards.
finding_closures.resolution: inventory requires finite positive number and energy; reconstructed and reference energies also require positivity. Ledger residuals require finite nonnegative values. Signed anisotropic stress remains allowed. Numerical tolerance values are unchanged.

finding_closures.original_issue: A zero-exit parent could leave an owned-session writer alive and be reported complete.
finding_closures.resolution: Both helper implementations probe only their exact owned PGID after parent reap. A surviving group becomes a failure and is cleaned; the actual parent exit code is retained.

finding_closures.original_issue: Exact-PGID-only observation omitted nested-session compiler and native process RAM/CPU.
finding_closures.resolution: Read one procfs process table and aggregate owned PGID members plus their observed PPID descendants. Report observed PIDs, nested live count and RSS. Ancestry is accounting only; signal targeting remains exact owned PGID.
finding_closures.dynamic_check: Existing production helper test requires real child/grandchild PID, positive nested RSS, and at least three live processes in the outer owner observation.

finding_closures.original_issue: Optional owner reuse made a run-tree symlink that the strict return-bundle utility rejects.
finding_closures.resolution: prepare copies the pinned, verified upstream files to a new local runtime tree and verifies each copy. The existing owner source is read-only.

preserved_boundaries: Only one previously incomplete b9_n64_P2P4 native case is in the reviewed native contract; no completed S8/S9/S10/S11 campaign is authorized here.
Original owner 0e25846433170d0f420c4cda44a0bedbf02cd177, one-case CSV, full runtime source hashes and old-stock full-array SHA256 are checked by the native wrapper/observer.
Native angular accuracy remains a separate diagnostic; process/packaging success is not full spectral-history or native Einstein/shear shared-Q completion.
Job attempts and outer completed receipts are create-only. The native final JSON is create-only and fsynced; the outer atomic receipt and JSON acceptance gates remain the completion authority.
Only source/input/command/dependency/artifact-identical PASS is eligible for resume; failures and interruptions remain separate attempts.
No signal is sent from a load estimate or inferred descendant PID. Only process groups created by the job wrappers are termination targets.
CPU64/RAM128GiB is a requested NCP ceiling; actual affinity/cgroup/free-memory/load bound admission. No actual NCP64 execution is claimed.
Disk protection is reservation plus sampled allocated-block checks and per-file limits, not a newly installed filesystem hard quota.
limitations: Procfs observations are not atomic or continuous. Reparenting before observation may remove ancestry; reviewed wrappers retain supervision until owned children finish.
RSS is sampled and may count shared pages more than once; it is not an exact continuous peak.
Load admission does not reserve other owners future capacity. Existing owner work is never stopped to obtain resources.
No inference of scientific correctness follows from this source review or from infrastructure packaging.
